profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Professional with over 15 years of experience in different fields of the Software development process, which believe not only whether a problem can be solved, but also how efficiently the problem can be solved.
Possesses expertise in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, with a skill for progressing from problem statements to well-documented designs.
Advanced programming, Design and analysis of Algorithms. Database design. Troubleshooting.
Management skills to maximize levels of productivity in the Project team

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
✔Accountable for architectural decisions within the team and often across other squads in the ongoing development of the company's roadside assistance applications, from database design to zero-downtime product deployment, while providing significant support for both external customer-facing APIs and internal APIs.
✔ Acts as a gatekeeper for code quality, performing thorough code reviews to ensure high standards and minimize technical debt.
✔ Resolved a critical historical data synchronization issue between the main web roadside application and a microservice, improving data consistency and system reliability.

► TechStack: GraphQL, Ruby 3, Rails 7, Typescript, React, WebPack, Yarn, Javascript, PostgreSQL, Git, Sidekiq, Redis, ElasticSearch, Rspec, TDD, BDD, Cucumber, Docker, Stripe.
PM: Atlassian, Jira, CI/CD: Harness, CircleCI, CodeClimate, Datadog, Rollbar, Split.io, RuboCop.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
✔ Worked in a team of 3 software engineers to release the company’s second most important product, the Form Tracking system. This custom form builder generates an embedded HTML tag that allows users to dynamically render forms on their websites, collect form submission data, and generate attributions to provide a comprehensive overview of which marketing channels drive the most form completions.

✔ Developing and improving a suite of integrations with various vendor and third-party platforms, including HouseCallPro, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zapier, Google Data Studio, Acquisio, etc., using webhooks (both inbound and outbound) with minimal customer interaction through OAuth2 authentication. This enables the CallRail app to send internal event notifications to these third-party platforms on behalf of their clients, or to subscribe to events triggered on those platforms.

✔ As part of the company strategy to move from the large monolithic Rails app to microservices, assisted in the process of segmenting and decoupling the products relevant to the team using Packwerk and Rails Engines.

► TechStack: Docker, Ruby 2.5, Rails 5, Angular2, Typescript, WebPack, Yarn, Ruby Gems 2.4.5, Javascript, PostgresSQL, Git, Sidekiq, Redis, Kubernetes, Rspec, TDD, BDD, PM: Target Process, CI: SemaphoreCI.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Packwerk · OOP · CSS · BDD · RSpec · Systems Design · Rails Engine · HTML5 · gRPC · SASS · JavaScript · PostgreSQL · APIs · Ruby · Problem Solving · Ruby on Rails · Git · TDD · WebSocket

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
positions.description:
✔ Lead a team of 7 consisting of a Product Owner/Business Analyst, Product Support Engineer, QA Engineer, Software Reliability Engineer, and 3 Software Engineers.
• Conducting code and test automation reviews, ensuring adherence to standards, identifying areas for improvement, and addressing refactoring or upgrade needs.
• Manage assigned code repositories, ensure versioning standards are followed, Pull Requests are well-commented, tags and branches are properly named, and merge conflicts are resolved.
• Lead design sessions, propose design alternatives, mentor on design best practices, and follow up on design decisions to ensure proper implementation.
• Provide onboarding training for new hires.
• Controlling and managing the software development lifecycle phases of the project in hand.

✔ Assisted in the implementation of the NeuroDecision™ Algorithm created by Equifax to evaluate credit risk decisions using predictive models, as part of the core software engineer team. The NeuroDecision™ Technology  is an innovative explainable and interpretable feed-forward neural network solution monotonically constrained created by the internal data-scientist team.

✔  Involved in the improvement and performance of a custom domain-specific language (DSL) for service interfaces using XText ( open-source framework )
Performing Scoping and Linking Resolution, Semantic validation like dynamic type checking, object binding which confirm that scripts entered are semantically correct and can be compiled correctly.

✔  Involved in the DSL translation and code generation to Java Code.

► Tech Stack: Java 8 and Groovy 2, Spring 4, SpringBoot, Hibernate 4, MongoDB 2.4, PostgreSQL 9.4, Liferay 6.2, Apache Tomcat 8, Eclipse Modeling Framework 2.9 (EMF), Xtext 2.4, Apache VTL 1.7, JUnit 4.8, PowerMock, Mockito, Spock and Cucumber, Apache JMeter 3.3, Apache Maven 3, Git, PM: Jira-Bitbucket-Confluence-HipChat, CI: Jenkins. Methodology: SCRUM, Spotify Model. OS: macOS 10.12.6 - Sierra

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer( Ruby On Rails )
positions.description:
✔ Responsibilities included developing new features and fixing bugs in a legacy web user interface for online parking reservations.

✔ Assisted with the design and planning of migrating a legacy PHP RESTful API, acquired from another company, to the company's existing Rails API. During this process, outdated functionalities were deprecated and removed to align with the goals of internal business units. These units, responsible for the web development of the User Interface and mobile applications, would utilize the API to make HTTP REST calls for processing online parking reservations, either through User Interfaces built with Ruby on Rails framework or via the Android and iOS mobile apps.

► Tech Stack: Ruby 1.9.3, Rails 3.2.18, Ruby Gems 2.4.5, Bootstrap, Jquery, CoffeeScript, Backbone.JS, MySQL, HTML 5, SVN , RVM, Rspec,Cucumber,Capybara,PM:Jira-Stash-Confluence-Irssi, CI:Jenkins, APM:Newrelic. Methodology: SCRUM, OS:Ubuntu 14.04.1

positions.title: Ruby On Rails Developer - LAW-CRM
positions.description:
✔ Worked on the design and implementation of a CRM system within the legal industry framework to manage interactions with new leads, existing clients, former clients, business partners, and other lawyers.

✔ Built a real-time waitlist for each department of the law office to display the progress of each client while at the office, managing their waiting times and measuring the effectiveness of each legal department the client is going through. The main goal was to improve the efficiency of the legal process at the office.
